name: Nuobikan Artificial Intelligence Technology (Chengdu) Co., Ltd.
summary: Nuobikan Artificial Intelligence Technology (Chengdu) Co., Ltd. designs and develops an industrial application of advanced technologies including AI and digital twins that target areas of transportation, energy, and urban management. It focuses on AI Transportation; AI Energy; and AI Urban Governance. The company also provides integrated software and hardware solutions adopting comprehensive AI industry models for monitoring, inspection, and maintenance purposes.
